note: Shared defaults every migration run inherits from this scaffold, identical for every run. These are configured values, not measurements: nothing here says a model, image or workspace is ready; preflight measures that. A run's identity is not here either: the Developer Hub factory writes run-budget.json into the destination's initial commit, and that commit is when the budget is declared. See .hermes/lib/planner/run_declaration.py.

budget.clock: earlier of destination first commit and M1 dispatch; includes bootstrap

m5_delivery.note: assisted continuation after M4 close; separate from the 24h migration deadline; do not extend or rewrite that deadline

stopping_conditions: terminal M4 outcome in both modes; full and provisional outcomes reported separately
sealed unit or family retry budget exhausted
M5 PREFLIGHT/DEPLOY/VALIDATE stage runtime exhausted (1h/3h/1h, max_retries 1)
budget.continuation: live repair, rewind or harness replacement is an assisted continuation; preserve the initial deadline and record
